verdict.rationale: Canva's first-party docs describe an Apps SDK for building apps that run inside the Canva editor, adding elements, importing content and automating design tasks. A CLI supports creating and managing these apps, and they can be distributed publicly via the Apps Marketplace or privately to a team, with a monetization path. Missing for 10: no evidence of TypeScript typings or sample/starter code, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience.
